verdict.rationale: mParticle exposes broad APIs (event API, Platform API, Audiences API, Warehouse Sync API, IDSync, Consent) that cover most core UI functions, suggesting strong programmatic coverage, but there is no explicit documentation stating full UI/API parity, and newer AI-driven audience-building features (e.g., natural-language audience description) appear to be UI-only with no API equivalent mentioned. missing for 10: explicit UI-API parity statement, API access for AI/Copilot-style audience creation features, independent confirmation of parity.
